title: 第四章十二品造化青莲
slug: 洪荒无量道全本免费-洪荒无量道最新章节列表
content_zh:
其中灵宝分为后天与先天，后天灵宝大部分是人为炼制如广成子的番天印，也有天地生成的，如天地玄黄玲珑宝塔和鸿蒙量天尺，均是后天功德至宝，其威能不比先天至宝差；先天灵宝可分为先天法宝、先天灵宝和先天至宝，以先天禁制划分：一到十一层先天禁制是为先天法宝，十二到二十三层是下品先天灵宝，二十四到三十五层是中品先天灵宝，三十六到四十七层是上品先天灵宝，四十八层先天禁制的是极品先天灵宝，四十九层的是先天至宝。法宝的强弱根据禁制的多少来判断，先天灵宝比之后天灵宝则是多了天道至理可凭之悟道，较之后天灵宝更显玄妙。混沌青莲破碎即大半莲台化为先天至宝乾坤鼎镇压大地、混沌青莲的五片叶子化成了先天至宝为五行旗（中央戊己杏黄旗、东方青莲宝色旗、南方离地焰光旗、西方素色云界旗、北方玄元控水旗）镇压五方天地，均是拥有无量功德、无限威能的至宝，其他碎片化成各种先天灵宝，如有名的二十四定海珠混元金斗河图洛书山河社稷图诛仙剑阵地书落地金钱弑神枪乾坤图等等，可以说混沌青莲是洪荒万宝之祖。
但是混沌青莲在混沌中孕育出了四粒莲子，后来长成赫赫有名的四朵莲台：十二品造化青莲、十二品功德金莲、十二品业火红莲及十二品玄水黑莲，虽说都为十二品，但是造化青莲得到混沌青莲的遗泽，蕴含造化，比之其他三朵莲台更显玄奥，有成长为先天至宝的潜力。
风洛根据后世所知，功德金莲为鸿钧所得，后来赐予接引成为西方教镇压气运的至宝；业火红莲生于血海，为冥河老祖所得；玄水黑莲被魔祖罗睺得到，被炼制成煞气黑莲，镇压魔道气运；至于造化青莲却消失无踪，有传言被三清所分，就是有名的“红花白藕青莲叶，三教原来是一家”的说法。但如今，“这宗至宝现在是我的了，谁都不能夺走。”风洛暗暗想到。得了造化青莲，风洛就迫不及待地要去创造自己的修炼功法了，如果是之前，风洛想都不想，创造功法，那纯属玩笑，功法岂是那么容易创造出来的，君不见，后世传说道祖鸿钧成道后布道天地，才有了系统的修炼功法，之前都是自己摸索修炼，最好的就是得到盘古的传承有一些修炼之法，就是三清道尊，盘古元神所化，也只是得到盘古修炼的功法，而且还是残缺的，十二祖巫也是如此。
当然，洪荒中还有一桩修道至宝，就是教化神器造化玉蝶，那可是混沌青莲的三十六片花瓣所化，记载着三千大道，鸿钧就是得到大部分的玉蝶残片才借此成道的，可见造化玉蝶残片就是赤裸裸的修炼功法大全。“当然，现在的造化青莲比之也不遑多让，到底是二代混沌青莲，多少有些大道痕迹，凭着这些，还有自己的强大元神，一定可以创造出适合自己的功法。”想到此处，风洛也就加紧了行动，“可不能落后于他人啊！”找了一处清静的山谷作为闭关之所，开始祭炼起造化青莲来。
时间飞逝，一转眼已千年，当风洛祭炼完造化青莲的四十层先天禁制后，最后的一层无论他怎么努力都没用，到现在为此才明白原来他的元神还不够强，从中得到的信息也让他知道了他当时吸收的青灰色气体就是造化之气，才让他的元神变得如此强大，而且他也从中知道了修到境界的划分：仙道以下分为引气入体、炼气化神、炼神返虚、炼虚合道，之上才是仙道境界，化凡为仙，分为地仙、天仙、真仙、玄仙、金仙、太乙金仙、大罗金仙，之后更往上的境界就不得而知了，也不知道是不是就是后世说的圣人境界，当炼化完造化青莲的最后一层禁制就应该知道了。按照境界对应，自己现在可是是连仙道都未入，不过自己的元神境界与道行应该都到了太乙金仙之境，不然的话肯定无法炼化那么多层禁制。“造化青莲现在还是极品先天灵宝，按照传承记忆，要成长为先天至宝，需要经历漫长的岁月，不过自己倒是可以算计一番，取得其他三朵莲台或者他们孕育的莲籽，这样可以补足本源直接晋升为先天至宝，到时候自己也有一件至宝了，这绝对是能极大地提升自己的实力。”风洛暗暗盘算，要知道整个洪荒天地除了造化青莲之外，也只有五件先天至宝，分别为开天斧所化的太极图、盘古幡、混沌钟，以及混沌青莲破碎化出的乾坤鼎以及五片莲叶所化的天地五方旗，而且天地五方旗是五件聚在一起才是先天至宝，分开的话就是五件极品先天灵宝，由此可见风洛得到一件先天至宝是多么幸运的事。

content_en:
Among them, the spiritual treasures are divided into acquired and innate treasures. Most of the acquired spiritual treasures are artificially refined, such as Guangchengzi's Pantian Seal, and some are generated by heaven and earth, such as the Xuanhuang Exquisite Pagoda of Heaven and Earth and the Hongmeng Heavenly Measurement Ruler. They are all acquired treasures of merit and virtue, and their power is no worse than the innate treasures. The innate spiritual treasures can be divided into innate magical treasures, innate spiritual treasures and innate treasures. Divided by innate restrictions: Levels one to eleven are innate magic treasures, levels twelve to twenty-three are low-grade innate spiritual treasures, levels twenty-four to thirty-five are mid-grade innate spiritual treasures, levels thirty-six to forty-seven are high-grade innate spiritual treasures, levels forty-eighth are top-grade innate spiritual treasures, and levels forty-nine are innate treasures. The strength of the magic weapon is judged by the number of restrictions. The innate spiritual treasure has more heavenly principles that can be used to understand the truth than the later spiritual treasure, and is more mysterious than the latter. The Chaos Green Lotus shattered, that is, most of the lotus platform turned into the innate treasure Qiankun Ding to suppress the earth, and the five leaves of the Chaos Green Lotus turned into the innate treasure into the Five Elements Flags (the central Wuji apricot yellow flag, the eastern Green Lotus treasure color flag, the southern flame light flag off the ground, the western plain color cloud boundary flag, and the northern Xuanyuan Water Control Flag) to suppress the five directions. Heaven and earth are treasures with immeasurable merit and infinite power. Other fragments are transformed into various innate spiritual treasures, such as the famous Twenty-Four Dinghai Pearls, Hunyuan Golden Douhe Pictures, Luoshu Mountains and Rivers, Sheji Pictures, Killing Immortals, Swords, Formations, Landing Money, God-killing Spears, Universe Pictures, etc. It can be said that the Chaos Green Lotus is the ancestor of all treasures in the world.
However, the Chaos Green Lotus gave birth to four lotus seeds in the chaos, and later grew into the famous four lotuses: the twelfth-grade Creation Green Lotus, the twelfth-grade Merit Golden Lotus, the twelfth-grade Karma Fire Red Lotus, and the twelfth-grade Mysterious Water Black Lotus. Although they are all twelfth-grade, the Creation Green Lotus received the legacy of the Chaos Green Lotus and contained good fortune. It is more mysterious than the other three lotuses and has the potential to grow into an innate treasure.
According to Feng Luo's knowledge of later generations, the Golden Lotus of Merit and Virtue was acquired by Hongjun, and was later given to Jieyin and became the most precious treasure of Western religions to suppress luck; the Red Lotus of Karma was born in the sea of blood and was acquired by the Ancestor Styx; and the Black Lotus of Xuanshui was acquired by the Demon Ancestor Luohu. It was refined into a black lotus of evil spirits to suppress the evil luck; as for the green lotus of creation, it disappeared without a trace. There are rumors that it was divided into three sects, which is the famous saying "Red flowers, white lotus roots and green lotus leaves, the three religions are originally one family". But now, "This treasure is mine now, and no one can take it away." Feng Luo thought to himself. After getting the Green Lotus of Creation, Feng Luo couldn't wait to create his own cultivation technique. If Feng Luo had not even thought about creating the technique before, it would be a joke. How could the technique be created so easily? Don't you see, it is said in later generations that Dao Zu Hongjun preached to the world after he became a Taoist. Only then did we have systematic cultivation techniques. Before, we had to explore and practice by ourselves. The best thing was to get some cultivation methods inherited from Pangu. Even the Taoist Sanqing, transformed by Pangu Yuanshen, only got the techniques cultivated by Pangu, and they were still incomplete. The same was true for the Twelve Ancestral Witches.
Of course, there is another treasure of cultivation in the ancient world, which is the sacred artifact of creation, the Jade Butterfly. It is made from thirty-six petals of the Chaos Green Lotus, which records the three thousand avenues. Hongjun obtained most of the Jade Butterfly fragments to become a Taoist. It can be seen that the Jade Butterfly fragments are a naked collection of cultivation techniques. "Of course, the current Green Lotus of Creation is not far behind. After all, it is the second generation of Chaos Green Lotus. It has some traces of the Great Dao. With these and its own powerful soul, he will definitely be able to create a technique that suits him." Thinking of this, Feng Luo stepped up his action. "We can't lag behind others!" He found a quiet valley as a retreat and began to practice the Green Lotus of Creation.
Time flies, and a thousand years have passed in the blink of an eye. When Feng Luo sacrificed and refined the forty layers of innate restraints on the Creation Qinglian, the last layer was useless no matter how hard he tried. Only now did he realize that his soul was not strong enough. The information he got from it also let him know that the blue-gray gas he absorbed at that time was the gas of creation.It made his soul become so powerful, and he also learned about the divisions of cultivation realms: below the immortal path is divided into introducing Qi into the body, refining Qi to transform into gods, refining gods to return to the void, and refining the void to combine with the Tao. Immortal, True Immortal, Xuan Immortal, Golden Immortal, Taiyi Golden Immortal, Daluo Golden Immortal, and the higher realms after that are unknown, and I don’t know if it is the realm of saints in later generations. You should know the last level of prohibition after refining the Green Lotus. According to the corresponding realm, he has not even entered the immortal realm now, but his Yuan Shen realm and Taoist practice should have reached the Taiyi Golden Immortal realm. Otherwise, he will definitely not be able to refine so many layers of restrictions. "The Creation Green Lotus is still the best innate spiritual treasure. According to the inherited memory, it will take a long time to grow into an innate treasure. However, I can make some calculations and obtain the other three lotus pedestals or the lotus seeds they bred. This can supplement the original source and directly be promoted to the innate treasure. By then, I will also have an innate treasure. This will definitely greatly improve my strength." Feng Luo secretly calculated. In addition to the Green Lotus, there are only five innate treasures in this prehistoric world. They are the Tai Chi Diagram, Pangu Flag, Chaos Bell formed by the Sky-Opening Axe, the Qiankun Cauldron formed by the shattering of the Chaos Green Lotus, and five lotus leaves. The five directional flags of heaven and earth were transformed into each other, and the five directional flags of heaven and earth were gathered together to form an innate treasure. If separated, they were five top-quality innate spiritual treasures. This shows how lucky Feng Luo was to get an innate treasure.
